ValidationRule.description: Ensuring that when Country is populated on the case then it can only be Australia when the recovery type = Australia
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, 'Bag Replacement'), NOT(ISBLANK( Country_Code__c ))), NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(Case_Number__r.Country__c, 'Australia'))), false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Bag Replacement recovery can only be done for customers in Australia
